name: Dead Last
summary: A social collusion party game where players secretly conspire and vote to murder each other to be the last survivor and collect gold.
rules_text: Each player has an ID color and voting cards for all colors plus an Ambush card. A round starts with 4 hidden Gold Bars in the center worth 3-5 points each. Players conspire openly or privately. Then all vote simultaneously by playing a target's card or Ambush. The player(s) with most votes are Targets. All tied Targets and all players who did not vote for a Target are eliminated from the round, except a Target who played Ambush survives and instead kills one of their voters. An Ambush that was not a Target self-eliminates. Reveal, eliminate, and repeat votes with survivors until one survivor remains and takes the 4 Gold, or zero remain and bystanders each gain 1 gold, or two remain and play a 3-option Final Showdown to split the gold. First to 25 points (24 with 10-12 players) wins.
rating_reason: Social collusion voting elimination game with bluffing and bargaining
